sn56.5:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhissanti || || Ye- -anāgatam addhānam- -abhisambujjhissanti || || Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || ||
sn56.5:2.1: Katamāni cattāri || || Dukkham ariyasaccam || la || dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā va yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || abhisambujjhissanti abhisambujjhanti || sabbe te imāni cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || ||
sn56.5:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhayāminī patipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo || ||
